tnTicket.title: Ticket
tnTicket.lede: The conversation, worker progress, the worker report and the read-only Git delivery check.
tnTicket.loadError: Could not read this task. Retry in a moment.

conversation.label: Transcript — j/k scroll one row
conversation.logNote: This log is the worker session. The task above is what you track and close.

actions.closeFailed: Could not close this task. The worker is still running.

composer.label: Composer
composer.placeholder: Reply to the worker, or press / at column 0…
composer.status: Enter sends · Shift+Enter (or Ctrl+J) newline · / at column 0 opens the palette prefilled with /
composer.sent: added to the task · Enter sends · Shift+Enter newline
composer.empty: nothing to send · Enter sends · Shift+Enter newline
composer.failed: Could not add this instruction. Retry in a moment.
composer.daemonFailed: Could not add this instruction. A daemon task accepts one only while it is blocked or waiting.
composer.trapPending: Confirm the request above first — the prompt is a trap in front of the composer.
composer.closedNote: This task takes no more instructions.
composer.daemonNote: This daemon task takes an instruction only while it is blocked or waiting.

progress.none: No worker progress for this task yet.

report.heading: Worker report
report.empty: No report yet. The worker writes one when it finishes or needs you.
report.question: Question

delivery.unsupported: this runtime cannot be checked — review the diff by hand
delivery.decisionNeedsYou: needs you — answer or retry on this page
delivery.contract: Ticket delivery contract: the worker commits its own changes before finishing, and the report above is the one it sends. This check is read-only Git state — it never mutates the workspace, and it runs again before any merge is allowed to land.

clarify.heading: Confirm the request before this ticket starts
clarify.review: Review the expanded request — edit anything that misses what you meant.
clarify.failed: Could not confirm. Retry in a moment.
clarify.status: Enter confirms · Shift+Enter (or Ctrl+J) newline · Esc returns to the composer
clarify.empty: nothing to confirm · Enter confirms · Shift+Enter newline
